title: GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation
title_zh: GHOST：面向开放词汇量三维场景图生成的几何约束混合扩散模型

paragraphs.en: GHOST是一种针对开放词汇量三维场景图生成的几何约束混合扩散模型，能有效处理空间谓词问题。 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.
paragraphs.zh: GHOST是一种针对开放词汇量三维场景图生成的几何约束混合扩散模型，能有效处理空间谓词问题。三维场景图生成需要同时理解对象语义和度量空间关系。 然而，现有的开放词汇方法在处理空间谓词时常常遇到困难，因为语言相似性反映的是语义共现，而非显式的几何结构。 我们提出了GHOST——一种用于开放词汇量三维场景图生成的几何约束混合扩散框架。 GHOST联合建模了连续节点几何与离散边谓词，遵循“几何-约束-谓词”的降噪流程，以确保关系预测在几何上的一致性。 该模型引入了基于语言的约束诱导机制，将谓词嵌入映射为可微分的几何约束，从而指导布局优化和谓词权重重调。 几何-拓扑协同降噪器进一步通过噪声自适应交互和方向感知建模，耦合了节点与边的推理过程。 在3DSSG上的实验表明，该模型在闭集和开放词汇设置中均达到了当前最优性能，尤其在空间谓词方面比RelationField提升了超过17个点。
